description: This file defines the interface 'WorkScheduleInterface' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\WorkSchedule' namespace. It declares method signatures related to work schedule properties such as shift times, non-working days, half days, and holidays, indicating its role in representing or managing work schedule data for employees in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: WorkScheduleInterface
classes.description: Interface that defines behavior for work schedule management, including shift timings and holiday checks.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the work schedule, possibly to associate schedule data with a specific employee.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the work shift in hours, as a float.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Provides the start and end times of the work shift, encapsulated in a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a non-working day (e.g., weekend or company holiday).

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a half working day.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is recognized as a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a holiday that is also a half day.
